prior_information: Original 2003-2025 country results and November 1-13 2026 observations were already inspected. January-October 2026 measurements have not been inspected in this audit.

mask_case.selection_reason: A geographically fixed two-degree western Mexico study area in the usual broad spring burning season; selected before reading its 2026 observations. No selection on observed outcomes.
mask_case.match_rule: Choose the first available daytime Aqua and NOAA-20 granules intersecting the fixed bounds on the fixed date, report actual time difference; do not label as time matched unless within 30 minutes. Retain every retrieved pair and explicitly report if no match or data access.
mask_case.no_substitution: Do not substitute a different date/location on observing weak results.

analysis: Keep original quarter and spatial/monthly candidate parameters frozen. No fitting or selection using the new observations. NRT differs from standard processing and is not ground truth. Full masks require geolocation and product QA interpretation; daily composite availability alone does not establish observation exposure.
publication: Scratch acquisition and audit only; parent reviews before integration.
